6. 如圖所示為 $y = a(x + b)^2$ 的圖像，其中 $a$ 及 $b$ 均為常數。下列何者正確？
A. $a > 0$ 及 $b > 0$
B. $a > 0$ 及 $b < 0$
C. $a < 0$ 及 $b > 0$
D. $a < 0$ 及 $b < 0$
reasoning: The graph shows a parabola opening upward, which implies $a>0$. Its vertex lies on the positive $x$‑axis, so $-b>0$, i.e. $b<0$. Thus the correct statement is $a>0$ and $b<0$, corresponding to option B.
